---
name: New rule request
about: Suggest a security/privacy/payments/AI check AuditSaas should add
title: ""
labels: new-rule
---

**Risk:** What can go wrong if this isn't caught?

**Evidence pattern:** What in the code would indicate this risk (a specific
API call, config shape, missing check)? A real or realistic code snippet
helps a lot.

**Recommendation:** What should a team do to fix it?

**Category:** Which existing category does this belong to (see `rules/` for
the list), or does it need a new one?

**Standards:** Any relevant OWASP/ASVS/etc. mapping, if known.
